stations.title: Bridget
stations.say: Can the laptop check our prices?
stations.note: Small boxes went out as large.

stations.title: Price file
stations.text: Changed often, and nobody checks it.

stations.title: Friday boxes
stations.text: Priced before they leave the farm.

captions: Thistlecombe Farm packs veg boxes. Bridget wants the laptop to check the prices.
Today the price file changes often and nothing checks it, so mistakes reach customers.
You write the farm's first tests, and read two old ones that fail.
Now a wrong price shows up as a failing test before Friday's boxes go out.
Same prices, same file. The laptop checks them, and Bridget hears first.
